How we work

Start with the business, then make the content.

01 / Listen

Tell us what you sell, who you want to reach and what you can realistically maintain.

02 / Plan

We agree on the channels, content types, responsibilities and production scope.

03 / Create

We make and publish the agreed work, then review what the audience responds to.

Common questions

Before we begin.

Do you offer one-time work or monthly support?

Both. Content Studio is designed around content production, while Social Management covers ongoing planning and publishing. The final scope depends on your business.

Can you work with a small shop or personal seller?

Yes. We can plan product content and practical social support around a smaller operation. See the industries we cover.

Is advertising spend included in a plan?

Advertising spend is quoted separately. The current plans are starting points; deliverables and pricing are agreed with you before work begins.

Which languages and platforms do you support?

We plan content for Burmese and English audiences across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok, depending on the channels your customers use.
